faq.question: Is QuizIn free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. QuizIn is free — create a room, invite friends with a 6-letter code, and start playing. No account or download is required.

faq.question: How many players can join a quiz room?
faq.answer: Free rooms hold 4 players. Each Premium player in the lobby unlocks +1 seat, up to 8. Guests and free accounts can fill the free seats.

faq.question: What quiz modes are available?
faq.answer: Classic Quiz is multiple-choice trivia with a shared timer. Geography Quiz shows a country name — players click the country on an interactive world map. The host picks the mode in the waiting room.

faq.question: Do I need to install anything?
faq.answer: No. QuizIn runs in your browser. For local development the game server must be running; in production the site connects automatically.

faq.question: How does scoring work?
faq.answer: In classic mode, faster correct answers earn more points. Geography mode rewards whoever finds the country on the map first. After the last question you see a leaderboard and review.
